mechanics.claim: Mordekaiser gains the stats he takes from the target (AP, attack speed, max HP, armor, MR) for himself for the duration.
mechanics.quote: '''Mordekaiser''' gains the reduced stats of the target for himself for the same duration

mechanics.claim: If the target dies while in the Death Realm, Mordekaiser keeps the stolen stats until they respawn.
mechanics.quote: if the target dies while inside the ''Death Realm'', he keeps their partial stats until they [[death|respawn]]

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast, not on effect end.
The health-reduction true damage ignores invulnerability, shields, and resistances, and does not interact with any effect such as items or runes.
The health-reduction damage does not apply damage modifiers, lifesteal, or omnivamp, and does not trigger on-hit or damage events.
Realm of Death cancels and goes on cooldown if the target is displacement immune, CC-immune, or protected by a spell shield during the cast.
mechanics.quote:
will cancel and go on cooldown after its cast time if:
** The target is {{tip|displacement immune}}, {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immune}} or protected by a {{tip|spell shield}}

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable, dies, is too far away, or Mordekaiser loses sight of them, the ability cancels without going on cooldown.
mechanics.quote: this ability will cancel but does not go on {{sti|cooldown}}

mechanics.claim: Realm of Death does not trigger in-combat status effects.
mechanics.quote: ''Realm of Death'' does not trigger [[Combat_status|in-combat]] effects.

mechanics.claim: The healing from Realm of Death is affected by healing modifiers.
mechanics.quote: ''Realm of Death's'' {{tip|healing}} is affected by healing modifiers.

mechanics.claim: If the target's current health is lower than the amount that should be stolen, they are brought down to 1 health, but Mordekaiser still gets the full intended max health.
mechanics.quote: If the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} is lower than the amount that should be stolen, they will be brought down to 1 health. '''Mordekaiser''' will still get the intended amount of {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.
